scope: center-recovery/supervise.py thin delegation to previously approved afd01a shared module

conclusions.interface: Original callable signature and legacy result fields remain; Launch uses explicit current cwd/environment, fixed repository-local shared module, childPidOnly ownership and default separate capture. No duplicated supervision loop. The old CLI execute flag, fixed Node/operator path and result exit mapping remain.
conclusions.ownership: Only the directly spawned unreaped operator PID is signaled. Detached services are not stopped by this wrapper. Existing standby test demonstrates a detached child survives wrapper deadline and is later stopped solely by test-owned cleanup.
conclusions.deadline: Policy maps work_seconds, zero TERM grace and exit_seconds to the previously approved childPidOnly policy. Independent stop decision does not wait on operator filesystem writes. Parent JSON printing/durable report after supervise returns is explicitly outside this deadline.
conclusions.conservativeChanges: Success additionally requires known child absence, no supervision failure and all actual pipe EOFs. New combined 65536-byte output cap is explicitly documented; overflow or incomplete/unknown termination cannot report success. Spawn failure cannot fabricate operatorStopped. Primary and secondary failures remain distinct.
conclusions.protectedOperator: operator.mjs is byte-identical to fixed 78fb37704d708e3b3b6ea4f1810947f012666196 at implementation and delivery; 8729 bytes, SHA256 2a5eee0c10604aa4df2a4fc9ee0bdf0da86f14ea154247ddeb9bff3fd960bff0. No authorization or recovery behavior changed.
conclusions.sourceScope: Implementation commit changes exactly the two declared wrapper/test paths. The two additional center-recovery metadata paths in the cumulative 78fb comparison are inherited records, not this implementation delta. Shared module source/test/README at implementation/current remain byte-identical to approved afd01a.

limits: Approval covers this first actual wrapper source migration and its two stand-in direct-consumer checks. No personal recovery was executed.
Previously approved shared-module tests were not rerun or re-audited as a new matrix; do not describe combined history as a single 17/17 run.
SVC07 remains unmigrated. No assertion that both real consumers are complete.
Future personal recovery still requires a new fixed source/authorization/window. Old consumed authorization is not reopened.
No new claims of detached-service-wide isolation, OS hard deadlines for parent persistence, or physical resource reclamation.
